answer.value:
Functions of the Economic and Social Council:
Study and report about international economic, social, and cultural matters
Issues like refugees, status of women, housing etc come under its purview
Recommendations for human rights fundamental freedom

Structure:
This organ consists all the members of the U.N
Each member country can send 5 members
They have single vote
It elects 17 vice Presidents and 7 Chairmen for the 7 standing Committees
The Assembly at its first session elects a President for a term of one year
Functions:
Session from September to December
Special session if any urgent matters need to be discussed
Major decisions require the approval of 2/3 of the members present
The annual budget has to be approved by this general meeting
It plays a leading role in the discussion of all major events in the world

questions.text: Explain the composition and functions of the Security Council.
questions.text_as_printed: Explain the composition and functions of the Security Council. (A 2019/P1-2024/Jul 2020/Sep 2020) (Average)

answer.value:
Structure and Functions of the Security Council
Structure:
It is known as World Cabinet
Consists 5 permanent and 10 non-permanent members
U.S.A., Russia, Britain, France and China are permanent members
Non-permanent 10 members are elected for a term of two years
Each member country has one vote
Permanent members have VETO power
Functions:
Permanent countries have VETO power
Solving international disputes through peaceful means
Direct the UN peace keeping force (IPKF) for international peace
Elects the judges of the International Court of Justice.
Recommends the name for the post of the Secretary General
